remediated_audit_issues.title: Canonical ZQA Contract Drift & Gate Sequence Mutation
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: Autonomous OPC test suite drifted from canonical ZQA gate definitions (ZQA-01..12), substituting ad-hoc names and broken order.
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Bound 12 canonical gates + 7 supplementary gates in zqa-contract-map.json and aligned test_autonomous_opc_gates.cjs.

remediated_audit_issues.title: Synthetic WebKit Emulation via Chromium User-Agent Impersonation
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: Cross-browser gate launched Chromium/Edge setting Safari UA string rather than invoking real WebKit browser engine.
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Installed Playwright real WebKit 26.6 & Chromium 153 engines; updated test_playwright_cross_browser.cjs to run authentic dual engines with live metadata extraction.

remediated_audit_issues.title: Client-Side Commercial Authority & Partner ID Exposure
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: Exposed SECURE_PARTNER_CONFIG and TRACK_1_AFFILIATE_REGISTRY on client window, allowing client tampering and violating server authority.
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Purged all commercial partner identity objects from client; established server-side authority in /api/resolve-link.js with tamper tests.

remediated_audit_issues.title: Cadence Golden Hours Schedule Drift & Passive Watchdog
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: Sweeper and cron schedules drifted from exact 4 ICT slots (00:07, 11:37, 16:37, 20:07) and watchdog lacked active drill proof.
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Aligned cron and sweeper to exact slots; implemented run_watchdog_drill.cjs verifying automated recovery from MISSED_CADENCE anomaly.

remediated_audit_issues.title: Live Parity Unverified Assertion
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: Parity report asserted live deployment match without downloading live served bytes from production URL.
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Created verify_live_artifact.cjs to download raw bytes from https://jayt-production-v3420.vercel.app/jayt_apex_interface.js, hash SHA-256, and verify bit-identical match.

remediated_audit_issues.title: Image Provenance Overclaim & Conflation with Reachability
remediated_audit_issues.root_cause: HTTP 200 reachability was conflated with unbox provenance verification; UI displayed overclaims ("Không Photoshop · Camera Thường").
remediated_audit_issues.remediation_summary: Differentiated asset_reachable vs asset_provenance_verified in image-provenance-report.json; replaced all UI copy with neutral honest labels ("Ảnh Sản Phẩm Từ Nguồn").
